The name Chokri carries the meaning “Gift from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Chokri usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
